title: Oliver Stables
specs: Indoor arena 60' x 100' with crushed stone/rubber surface and irrigation
Outdoor arena 120' x 250' with sand base and lighting for night riding
Easy access to miles of bridle trails from the property
EIA (Coggins) test within 30 days before arrival
Vaccinations within 30 days for Rabies, Tetanus, Eastern and Western, Flu, Rhino, Potomac Fever, and West Nile
Worming and dental exam required before arrival
General health certificate dated no earlier than 30 days before arrival
Horse isolated for 3 days upon arrival
Worming program six times a year coordinated by Mr. Oliver
Only two other persons age 12 or older with prior horse experience allowed to share board

includes: Feeding service provided twice daily per owner's customized instructions
One flake of hay once a day in the stall and in turnout corrals year-round
Turn out to corral (dry lot)/pasture in AM and brought in during PM
Blanketing – one blanket on and off daily
Water in stalls, corrals (dry lots), and pastures
Sawdust provided for daily cleaning (owners clean stalls unless paying for stall cleaning)
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests board their horses with options for basic care or additional stall cleaning services. Horses receive feeding twice daily per owner's instructions, turnout to corrals or pastures, blanketing, and water access. The facility includes indoor and outdoor arenas, wash racks, and access to bridle trails.
tags: Basic Boarding with Stall Cleaning (alternative prices)
extraNote: Board rent due on first of the month, checks to Oliver Stables, LLC · No smoking on premises · No dogs allowed on premises · Independent instructors must have $1,000,000 A-rated insurance filed in advance · Group lessons not allowed; one instructor per rider/horse · Riders 16 and under require adult supervision or approved instructor for riding or jumping
